# system.getInstructionsUsage

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.1.3</span></div>

Return the percentage of Lua instructions already used in the current script execution cycle.

```lua
local usage = system.getInstructionsUsage()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

usage (integer): 0 to 100, the script is aborted when reaching 100

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function wakeup()
  while system.getInstructionsUsage() < 80 do
    -- process the next chunk of a long task
  end
end
```
